subject: planner: fix incorrectly using the schema for plan cache (#57964)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent, focusing on `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go` plan-cache preprocessing. The change fixes a real correctness risk by ensuring `tryLockMDLAndUpdateSchemaIfNecessary` is called with the current `InfoSchema` table (including MDL-attached updates) instead of potentially stale `stmt.tbls[i]`, and it invalidates `RelateVersion` on MDL/schema update errors to avoid unsafe plan-cache reuse. Checked surrounding call-paths (`tryLockMDLAndUpdateSchemaIfNecessary` in `pkg/planner/core/preprocess.go` and cache-key composition in `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache_utils.go`) for correctness/txn/MDL semantics; no remaining Blocker/High issues found. Upstream/master retains the same core logic in this area (no later fix required).
